as_told.title: Mussolini asks Hitler about the Magenta craft

plain: In 1933, the story goes, an unknown flying object crashed near Magenta in Italy, and the Italian dictator Benito Mussolini went to the German leader Adolf Hitler about it. Michels tells it twice, calling it a rumour. In one telling it is a kind of partnership between the two, and in the other Mussolini simply asks the Nazis, "Is this yours?" If true, it would put a crashed craft in fascist hands more than a decade before the Second World War ended.
